data.name: Fikriyya
data.gender_notes: Fikriyya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Fikriyya is an Arabic name derived from the root 'fakara' which means to remember or to think. This name signifies a person who is deeply engaged in their thoughts and memories. In Islamic context, Fikriyya is a name of high reverence as it is associated with the remembrance and contemplation of Allah. The name Fikriyya carries the meaning “Memory, Thought, Intention” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fikriyya usually hope their child will grow to embody memory, thought, intention and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that evokes the remembrance and deep contemplation of Allah.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fikriyya total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
